# Search Engine Crawling & Indexing Policy

User-agent: Googlebot
User-agent: Bingbot
User-agent: Slurp
User-agent: DuckDuckBot
User-agent: Baiduspider
User-agent: YandexBot
User-agent: *

# Allow public news stream, articles, multimedia explore, and legal pages
Allow: /
Allow: /explore
Allow: /article/
Allow: /privacy
Allow: /sitemap.xml
Allow: /rss.xml

# Disallow private user accounts, dashboards, admin consoles, and API endpoints
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /studio
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /api/

# Crawl Delay to protect server telemetry
Crawl-delay: 2

# XML Sitemap Index
Sitemap: https://pulsenews.global/sitemap.xml
